_comment: Declarative derivation rules for the generated project fixtures.
scripts/generate_test_projects.py reads this file and writes the derived
projects into the build tree; nothing here is committed as YAML.
Variants are processed in order and each variant's 'sources' globs are
resolved against the committed project tree first and then against the
already-generated variants, so a variant may build on an earlier one.

variants.name: stacking-captures
variants.description: Four captures of each pressing: fresh capture seeds, the pressing's shared noise and channel untouched. Capture 2 starts later (PN 5); capture 3 replays the multi-burst range (PNs 9-12).

variants.name: stacking-clean
variants.description: Disc-simulation sources and pressing captures with the impairment blocks removed, for reference comparisons against the noisy captures. The project-level channel block is kept: it is part of the pressing's truth.

variants.name: stacking-yc
variants.description: Y/C (separate luma/chroma) renderings of every stacking project, composite and clean alike.
